text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Not agaaain. Ughhh, I've been<n>waking up so early
recently.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That part-time job I've been doing<n>does involve a
lot of sitting down...<n>Maybe I'm not getting enough
exercise?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I should really be getting proper<n>rest. Okay, I'll
just go back to sleep...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Scratch that! I want to get out there<n>and run!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Ines Fujin is so eager<n>to run that
she's waking up early and<n>missing out on sleep...
